meta.what: Stroeymeyt et al. 2018 detection tracker, per fit colony and role (nurse, forager; the queen uses the nurse tracker). Frozen 2026-10-15 (user approval, STATUS Decisions log 2026-10-15 late evening). Never tuned to behaviour rows.
meta.role: observer model; estimated from detection patterns of the fit colonies only (PreTreatment, even UTC hours), validated on odd hours
process: In the nest, after each detection a gap starts (next frame missed) with probability 1 - (1 - p[cell])^m.

cell = observed class (6) x time since detection resumed (6); index = class * 6 + tsbBin. Definitions: src/sim/analysis/detection.ts (ObservedState, detectionCell); the same code classifies recorded tracks and the simulated observer.

classes: moving or still < 10 s since an observed moving step; still 10-60 s; still 60-300 s; still >= 300 s; still after a break (age unknown); fresh (first detection after a break). Still: step < 0.6 mm per frame; gaps <= 3 frames bridged; a gap >= 4 frames is a break.
m: per-ant onset multiplier drawn from `mult` (even-hour estimates of ants with >= 2000 opportunities; [1] if fewer than 5 such ants).

duration: bin from dProb[tsbBin of the onset] over DET_D_EDGES (missed frames), uniform within a bin, last open bin capped at 2 x 7200 frames (deviation from the agreed shared duration: P(D >= 4 | gap) falls 0.46 -> 0.13 across tsb bins for nurses, 0.42 -> 0.11 for foragers, even and odd hours equal to 0.01).
Outside the nest (arena) detection stays independent per frame at the colony rate: an explicit assumption when reading trip results.

estimator.version: est3 (joint): baseline hazard h_c (m = 1) per cell and per-ant multipliers by alternating moment matching, onset 1 - exp(-m_i h_c), geometric mean of estimated m fixed at 1; ants with < 200 opportunities keep m = 1; cells with < 200 opportunities or no gaps fall back to the pooled (all fit colonies) hazard. Durations: Kaplan-Meier per tsb bin (exportTracker2); a bin with < 300 gaps borrows the next shorter bin's distribution. Foragers: opportunities whose next detection is outside the nest excluded (exits).

committed code.reproduction (2026-10-15): counts identical to the scratch pass (logs/tmpTrackerData3.json); estimates within 3.3e-14 relative of the payload (libm vs V8 last bits); payload kept as frozen

validation.held-out (data, odd hours, each ant's ev: odd-hour gaps predicted within 1-4 % per tsb bin and class; P(gap >= 4) inside the odd-hour 90 % interval in 22/22 colonies (nurses and foragers); per tsb bin P(D >= 3 | gap) 17-22/22, S(D >= 40) 14-20/22 (sparse long-tsb tails weakest); per-colony parameters needed (pooled: 8/22).

coupled (simulated colonies at S2018_STA.nurses: onset per cell sim/data 0.94-1.05 (>= 1200 s 0.8-1.26, sparse); onset per observed class 17-22; pMiss standardized to the data's state mix 21, detection standardized 22; S(D >= 40/600/2400) 20/22/22; multipliers 19-22.
coupled (simulated colonies at S2018_STA.foragers: onset per class 19-22; pMiss standardized 22, detection standardized 22; S(D >= 40/600/2400) 21/22/20; multipliers 21.
coupled (simulated colonies at S2018_STA.fails by state mix (behaviour), not per: raw in-nest pMiss 0.061 vs 0.041 (nurses), raw detection row 0.729 vs 0.815 median colony, lower in all 22; tsb-marginal onsets 60-1200 s and the after-break class. Kept visible as a joint model-and-observer diagnostic.

limitations: arena detection independent (forager outside detection not modelled)
dProb borrowed from the shorter bin where a bin has < 300 gaps
